dictionary.september_change: Table 16 October text lists three September 2026 provider additions and new risk-based survey footnote 29. Older render lacks these additions. Exact dictionary bytes not pinned.

methodology.scope: Staffing intensity and annual turnover are separate measures. Health inspection rating uses two standard-survey cycles plus three years of specified complaint/infection-control evidence, with exclusions and adjustments. Fire safety citations are not part of this rating.
